theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ : ℝ) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r : ℝ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, ι v ∈ T) → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ x ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall ξ r, ‖(x - ξ) - T.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall ξ r → ∀ v : Euclid n, x = ξ + ι v + ι' (f v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)) → (∀ j : Fin k, ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ (fun v => EuclideanSpace.proj j (f v)) (P (x - ξ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ r, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) ∧ ∀ (j : Fin k) (ζ : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2) → (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun v => EuclideanSpace.proj j (f v)) (P (x - ξ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ (P (x - ξ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂R.measure| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal G * (∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ r, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure + R.measure (closedBall ξ r \ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v))) + ENNReal.ofReal (κ * r / 2) * R.measure (closedBall ξ r))
